control._why: Voice of Victory stops counterspells on their turn, No More Lies fights back, Krang refills, Rest in Peace stops graveyard recursion. Cuts creature removal and Authority.

midrange._why: More board wipes vs a creature deck.

aggro._why: More Authority of the Consuls and Day of Judgment to slow and reset creature decks. Cuts slow utility artifacts. (added 2026-11-23 for the meta round robin)

graveyard._why: Added 2026-11-26: their best against graveyard-based aggro decks (graveyard hate, cards that stop enter triggers, cheap removal, sweepers). Rest in Peace, Torpor Orb, Authority of the Consuls and more sweepers. Cuts the slower artifacts.
